research_scope: Source-free independent Wave2 review of eight type-matched missing-prerequisite identity pairs; original source formulations preserved; no mathematical or citation certification, no consolidation gate.

aliases.reason: The short-exact-sequence source explicitly uses the symbols 0→A→B→C→0 in an abelian category, where 0 denotes the zero object (both initial and terminal). The additive-category source likewise requires a zero object, both initial and terminal. These are the same underlying categorical prerequisite; exactness, images, kernels and individual sequence arrows stay with the parent source.

The representable presheaf h_U acts on g:Y→X by precomposition Hom_C(X,U)→Hom_C(Y,U), f↦f∘g. The functor-of-points h_X acts on α:T′→T by the identical precomposition operation Hom(T,X)→Hom(T′,X), h↦h∘α. Objects differ but the categorical prerequisite is the same operation preserving identities and composition. The representability, scheme and contravariance data remain source-specific.

The independently sourced proper vertex k-coloring formulations both use the exactly specified label set {1,…,k} for integer k≥1 as the color codomain. The provisional formula explicitly states that c need not be surjective and the screened formula has the same c:V→{1,…,k} convention; both prerequisites denote the same finite label palette, not the proper-coloring constraint itself.

The affine fibre-product source asserts a canonical isomorphism of schemes over Spec(A), and the affine closed-subscheme source asserts an isomorphism of schemes over Spec(R). In both, an S-scheme isomorphism is an invertible scheme morphism whose forward and inverse maps commute with the fixed structural maps to S; A/R are dummy coefficient-ring variables. The fibre-product tensor construction and closed immersion remain separate mathematical parent conditions.

The two provisional affine-hull formulations define or characterize aff(S) in R^d using the finite affine combination Σ_{i=1}^k α_i x_i with Σα_i=1 and no positivity constraint. The alternate affine-closed-intersection formulation explicitly requires closure under exactly such combinations. Thus both candidate labels are the same affine-combination prerequisite. The aff(S)=∅ convention for S=∅ belongs to the parent affine-hull variant and is preserved.

The continuous-indexed martingale formulation and the real-time adapted stochastic-process formulation both use the increasing family (F_t)_{t≥0} of σ-algebras for every real t≥0, with F_s⊆F_t whenever s≤t. Their shared prerequisite is a continuous-time filtration, distinct from the separately present discrete-time (F_n) filtration. Martingale conditional expectations and process adaptedness remain source-specific.

In the algebraically closed field source, a root a∈K of a nonconstant polynomial f∈K[x] means f(a)=0. In the irreducible polynomial quotient, splitting-field and separable-degree sources, a root α in a field extension E/F means f(α)=0 after coefficient inclusion. The first is precisely the K=F=E special case of the second polynomial-root prerequisite. Neither is confused with a root of unity or a field radical.

Both candidate identities occur in the SAME provisional trace-of-a-square-matrix source: K is a field, n≥1 and A=(a_ij)∈M_n(K). A square n-by-n matrix over K and a square matrix of finite order n≥1 over K are the identical underlying linear-algebraic prerequisite in this source, not alternative sizes, rings or matrix operations. The diagonal sum defining trace remains separate.
